 The sampler retains at most 32 MiB of private working surfaces by default, using the existing byte/entry-bounded Canvas cache. Keys include bitmap identity, channel/inversion, exact source crop, output grid and smoothing. Returned canvases are caller-owned copies, never cache-owned buffers; the caller must release them. Reset/disposal invalidates pending publication, and cancellation/source ownership/lifetime checks reject stale results. Worker inputs/settings are copied before readiness and returned type/extent are validated. Cache-copy allocation failure releases its private surface and preserves successfully prepared caller output. The sampler borrows the pixel processor and does not dispose it or the source assets.
 
-This preparation service is **not yet connected to authored strokes, stamp geometry, GPU/SVG replay, tools or portable brush presets**. No public `BrushTexture` constructor, schema change, script/plugin privilege, REST operation or completed F06 feature is claimed. The dated roadmap records verification and the remaining integration work.
+`prepareAffine` additionally projects the original bitmap directly into a bounded working tile through a complete validated source-to-output affine map. The existing transform schema rejects singular/nonfinite matrices; mapped source bounds must remain finite. No source-sized intermediate is allocated. The output-domain alpha inversion includes transparent pixels outside the projected image; callers must apply the intended footprint. Native conversion still happens after projection/sampling.
+
+`TexturedStrokeRaster` is an internal asynchronous raw-ink replay adapter, in verification. Texture coverage stretches over the existing normalized ellipse or pencil rectangle, modulating its native hardness coverage. Roundness, tilt, pressure and full symmetry copies use the existing shared stamp grid. A texture's orientation matters even on a round tip, so `paintStampGeometry` has an internal optional `preserveTipAngle` flag; the default retains existing isotropic geometry for every current app caller. Each dab projects original texture pixels into at-most-1024×1024 output tiles, then applies native footprint coverage and flow. The caller must apply captured selection and whole-stroke opacity once afterward. No point/sample is replaced or dropped.
+
+Append-only replay retains at most a 16 MiB raw prefix, with a separate private staging surface during asynchronous updates. Results reach the caller target and replace the retained prefix only after source/lifetime/cancellation checks. Cancelled partial work cannot advance the prefix. Larger output surfaces replay ephemerally without rejecting their geometry. Source identity/settings/view changes invalidate the prefix; concurrent requests serialize and clear/dispose invalidates pending requests. Returned source tiles are released after drawing, and the adapter borrows rather than closes its processor/assets. These working budgets do not describe whole-process peak memory or prove interactive frame rate.
+
+These internal adapters are **not yet connected to authored texture metadata, the app compositor/active tools, GPU/SVG replay or portable brush presets**. No public `BrushTexture` constructor, schema change, script/plugin privilege, REST operation or completed F06 feature is claimed. The dated roadmap records verification and the remaining integration work.
 
 `core/text-style.ts` applies the complete native font/spacing/direction state for text measurement, Canvas glyph drawing and SVG baseline preparation. It resets absent tracking/word spacing/kerning/direction and rejects unsupported nondefault word spacing/kerning before drawing. It retains native whole-line shaping instead of splitting glyphs or words. TextLayer setters, `resetSpacing` and strict layer.update share ordinary locks/history; typography patches require text layers. Immutable content signatures already include new primitive typography fields, invalidating reference/GPU glyph caches. Resize gestures capture complete typography and measure the new font size without overriding it with the captured size. Approximate headless bounds do not claim font parity. Schema 25 validates optional wordSpacing/fontKerning and gates them outside any immutable drawing proof; legacy roots/history migrate without inserted defaults. See the TextLayer guide for defaults, limits, feature detection and exact export behavior.
